segments.caption: A man in a white shirt stands beside a dark green Skoda estate car parked on a rural road, speaking directly to the camera while gesturing towards the vehicle, likely presenting or reviewing it in an outdoor setting.

A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors in front of a dark car, speaking directly to the camera. A subtitle appears, stating, “Please be advised: This tutorial is only a guide,” indicating he is delivering an instructional or cautionary message. The setting is a sunny, natural environment with trees and grass in the background.
A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors beside a dark car, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures against a backdrop of green trees and grass under bright daylight.
A man in a light-colored shirt stands outdoors beside a car, then moves to sit in the driver’s seat, looking toward the camera as he prepares to demonstrate or review the vehicle’s interior features.

He first grips the lever, then turns to face the camera while speaking, before returning his hand to the lever to show its operation. The scene takes place during the day, with greenery visible through the windows, suggesting a review or tutorial setting.

A man in a light blue shirt sits in the driver’s seat of a car, looking toward the camera. The scene cuts to a close-up of a car wheel, where a hand gently presses on the tire tread, likely to demonstrate its condition or texture.
A man in a high-visibility vest kneels beside a black car on the side of a road, gesturing toward the wheel as he speaks, likely explaining or demonstrating something related to the vehicle.
A person retrieves a blue roadside assistance kit from the trunk of a car, preparing for potential vehicle trouble.

A man in a high-visibility vest stands by his open car door, holding a breathalyzer device and a pen, appearing to prepare to conduct a roadside alcohol test.

A man in an orange safety vest crouches by a car on the roadside, demonstrating how to use a portable air compressor to inflate a tire. The close-up shots focus on his hands as he inserts the nozzle into the tire valve stem and operates the pump, while the wider shot shows him explaining the process to the viewer.
A person, wearing a high-visibility vest, kneels beside a car to check and inflate a tire using a portable air compressor, indicating a roadside tire maintenance task.

A person is using a portable air compressor to inflate a car tire. The sequence shows the hand connecting the hose to the valve stem, then plugging the compressor's power cord into a car's cigarette lighter socket, and finally operating the blue compressor unit to pump air into the tire.

A man in an orange vest kneels beside a car, using a portable air compressor to inflate a tire. He adjusts the pressure gauge, then connects the hose to the tire valve, demonstrating how to fix a flat tire on the roadside.

A man in an orange safety vest kneels beside a black car, speaking directly to the camera in an outdoor setting. The scene cuts to a close-up of the car's fuel cap, which clearly indicates it is a diesel vehicle and explicitly prohibits the use of bio-diesel.

A man in an orange safety vest stands in front of an open car trunk, speaking directly to the camera. The scene is set outdoors with trees in the background, suggesting a roadside or parking area. The man’s focused expression and direct address imply he is delivering information or instructions about the vehicle or the fueling process.

A man in an orange safety vest stands by an open car trunk, appearing to explain something. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a hand connecting an air hose to a tire valve stem, indicating he is demonstrating how to check or inflate a tire.

A man sits in the driver’s seat of a car, speaking as the vehicle moves through a green, wooded area. The scene cuts to a close-up of a hand using a tool to tighten a lug nut on a tire, indicating the man is likely performing a tire change or maintenance task while driving.

A man sits in the driver's seat of a car, looking intently at the camera and speaking, while a close-up shot shows a hand holding a pressure gauge, suggesting he is discussing or demonstrating something related to tire pressure or vehicle maintenance.

A driver, shown in a close-up inside his car, reacts with a look of frustration or alarm as a warning message appears on screen, instructing him to drive at 50mph, accelerate and brake gently, and to see a ŠKODA or tyre retailer immediately due to a temporary vehicle restriction.

A man with dark, curly hair sits in the passenger seat of a car, speaking directly to the camera. He wears a light blue collared shirt and maintains steady eye contact, his mouth moving as he talks. The background outside the car window shows a blur of green foliage, indicating the vehicle is in motion. The scene is consistently lit by natural daylight.

The video then cuts to text screens providing customer support information, first advising viewers to contact RAC for Skoda Roadside Assistance if they are unsure about using the kit, and then directing those who wish to purchase a spare wheel and kit to contact their local Skoda retailer.

The video displays a series of static informational screens for ŠKODA customers, first instructing viewers to contact their local retailer to purchase a spare wheel and kit, then listing useful contacts including the official website, roadside assistance, and customer services phone numbers, before fading to black.
